title: cartierPoleBoundary existsUnique
statement: For an effective Cartier closed immersion i:D→Z, there exists a unique beta in Ext^1(i_*Z_D,G_m) satisfying CartierPoleBoundarySpec [def-sp-cartier-pole-boundary]: its torsor generators lie above supported one and its canonical complementary frame maps to zero, for every open complement of D.

source.place: (G1), local lifts, and the prescribed complementary splitting

proof.text: On the complement of D the canonical section of the dual ideal is invertible and hence gives a frame of its etale torsor. The integral open-closed exact sequence represents sections on this complement, with its inclusion normalized by one.

source.place: (G1), local lifts, and the prescribed complementary splitting

proof.text: Apply the relative torsor-extension theorem to this torsor and chosen complementary frame. Its quotient is precisely i_*Z_D. Naturality of the integral support unit identifies its prescribed quotient section with supported one.

source.place: (G1), local lifts, and the prescribed complementary splitting

proof.text: Any other complement has the same underlying open, and its prescribed frame equals the canonical frame by injectivity of the frame-torsor realization. Thus every witness of CartierPoleBoundarySpec gives the same relative Ext class, proving uniqueness.

source.place: (G1), local lifts, and the prescribed complementary splitting

proof_origin.place: Relative torsor construction of the normalized pole boundary

theorem cartierPoleBoundary_existsUnique {D Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : D ⟶ Z)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hI : i.ker.IsInvertible) :
    ∃! β : Ext.{u + 1} ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).obj (supportedIntegralConstant D))
      Z.gmSheaf 1, CartierPoleBoundarySpec i hI β
